main_measure.name: mean unusual 10-bar move per long case

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 distinct case days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, top third by forecast minus bottom third

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom-third check above 0.
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise of at least 2 points from its lowest long level since the last bet) in each 10-bar grid cell of a window, its return taken from that bar's close 10 bars ahead within the window, the drift is the mean of the coin's grid 10-bar returns over all its windows, and the thirds are floor(n/3) cases at each end of the forecast ranking.
